question: A boat can travel 16.9 km downstream in 52 min. If the speed of the current is 3 km/h, then how much time (in hours) will the boat take to travel 84 km upstream?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Downstream speed** = (16.9 ÷ 52) × 60 = 19.5 km/h.

**Upstream speed** = Downstream speed − (2 × Current speed).

Upstream speed = 19.5 − (2 × 3) = 13.5 km/h.

**Time upstream** = Distance ÷ Upstream speed = 84 ÷ 13.5 ≈ 6.22 hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 6.22 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance downstream = 16.9 km, Time downstream = 52 min, Current speed (v) = 3 km/h, Distance upstream = 84 km.

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time; Downstream speed = u + v; Upstream speed = u − v (where u is boat speed and v is stream speed).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44039fa643fbec6ecb7c742e873d6166121c68486f5dcbd758bd9dfe5d08b12c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Downstream speed = 16.9 ÷ (52/60) km/h

⇒ Downstream speed = (16.9 × 60) ÷ 52 = 1014 ÷ 52 = 19.5 km/h

⇒ **Boat speed** (u) + **Current speed** (v) = 19.5

⇒ u + 3 = 19.5 ⇒ u = 16.5 km/h

⇒ **Upstream speed** = u − v = 16.5 − 3 = 13.5 km/h

⇒ **Time upstream** = Distance ÷ Upstream speed = 84 ÷ 13.5

⇒ Time = 840 ÷ 135 = 56 ÷ 9 ≈ 6.22 hr

**∴ The correct answer is 6.22 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Boats and Streams

When moving **downstream**, the speeds of the boat and the stream are added (u + v). When moving **upstream**, the speed of the stream is subtracted from the boat speed (u − v).

Calculating Still Water and Stream Speed

Speed in **still water** (u) = (Downstream speed + Upstream speed) ÷ 2. Speed of **stream** (v) = (Downstream speed − Upstream speed) ÷ 2.

Basic Time-Distance Relation

Time = Distance ÷ Speed. Always ensure all units are consistent (convert minutes to hours by dividing by 60).</p
